notes.title: Update to Demo 5/26/2025 - Fixes
notes.notes:
Greetings adventurers,

We've been working hard on polishing the experience — here are the latest changes and additions:

- Added health system with wrist module display.
- Added autosave and load functionality via the menu.
- Added new ability and weapon form selection menus.
- Introduced a new puzzle in the first room.
- Implemented weak points for sword-wielding enemies.
- Added crystals that block certain objects.
- Added an audio archive with extra lore recordings.
- Remote grab now works on climbing platforms.

- Adjusted shield activation behavior.
- Updated interactions with Karus.
- Reworked quest sequence inside the temple.
- Tweaked final boss stage.
- Changed flying AI behavior.
- Autopilot now activates during planetary departure.
- Updated visuals for the sandstorm.
- Balanced the number of enemies in the temple.

notes.title: Lore prologue about "Whispers Of The Void" Universe
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=pK07PU5zlDI;full][/previewyoutube]

Long ago, before life existed on Earth, the Galactic Confederation united four powerful civilizations: Kartam, Varn, Sarus, and Kiri. They maintained peace with immense armies aboard colossal motherships, all powered by a precious resource—Edem.

But over time, the Kartam vanished, merging into a "one mind" and leaving the galaxy. Without them, the remaining three civilizations waged war, culminating in a massive battle in the Yarus system, on the planet Cirus, each vying for control of Edem.

In the heat of battle, an unexpected catastrophe struck—Cirus collapsed under its own mass, consuming the entire system and most of the fleets. The survivors limped back to their systems, too weakened to continue the conflict.

With Edem now scarce and scattered across asteroid fields, the shattered factions formed a new Confederation. To preserve the balance, strict laws were established, restricting the use of Edem to small merchant ships and light vessels. Thus, the new Confederation endures, bound by these fragile rules.

notes.title: ByOwls finally announced the launch of the first playable demo
notes.notes:
Hello there!

We at ByOwls are super happy to finally announce the launch of our [b]first playable demo[/b], which will take you on a swashbuckling sci-fi journey across the galaxy. 

Now live as part of Steam Next Fest, the demo showcases the first full mission of the game, introducing players to some of the key gameplay mechanics found in [b]Whispers of the Void[/b].

You will begin the game aboard a spaceship, navigating its controls to warp to a distant desert planet. Upon arrival, you’ll get a taste of the game’s fluid VR combat that blends gunfights and energy sword fencing, solve an ancient puzzle, scale a mountain, and face off against the game’s first boss — all with the help of your trusty alien frog companion.

The [b]Whispers of the Void[/b] demo is available now on Steam for free, offering 30-60 minutes of gameplay.

[b]Whispers of the Void[/b] is a rip-roaring journey across the galaxy that combines space travel, puzzles in hostile environments, gunfights, and energy sword duels, all wrapped in a gripping sci-fi narrative. You will race against the clock for control over Edem, the most powerful substance in the universe. A cause of at least one planetary implosion, Edem offers a key to the puzzle that could stitch the galaxy back together — or tear it apart.

Armed only with your ship and your wits, it’s up to you to stop the collapse of civilization. The fate of the galaxy rests in your hands — hop on for a crazy ride!

notes.title: A new ‘Indiana Jones in space feat. alien frog dude’ VR adventure
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=GcmE_0Fc2Bw;full][/previewyoutube]

What if Indiana Jones was a space cowboy? Now we have the answer — we are thrilled to present [b]Whispers of the Void[/b], an immersive, story-driven sci-fi adventure designed from the ground up for VR.

In Whispers of the Void, you don the spacesuit of a relic hunter — a rare breed brave enough to venture into the farthest reaches of the universe. What starts like a routine retrieval mission on the desert planet Arena quickly spirals into a galaxy-spanning conspiracy. Commissioned by an old friend to recover a mysterious relic, you become a part of a hidden conflict over Edem, a substance with the potential to reshape the balance of power in the galaxy.

As the story unfolds, Whispers of the Void challenges you to master VR combat — wielding both guns and laser swords — solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the secrets of ancient alien civilizations. The fate of the galaxy and all life within it rests with you!

We’re also releasing a [b]debut gameplay trailer[/b], offering a first look at the game’s vibrant and painterly aesthetic, fluid combat mechanics, and cinematic set pieces that await players in the full game.

[b]Key features[/b]

[*]Explore New Worlds. Dive into hand-crafted VR environments, ranging from eerie alien tombs to the hostile surfaces of unknown planets, each with its own unique visual identity and atmosphere.

[*]Reach the Farthest Corners of Space. Take command of your own spaceship, navigate between distant planets, and engage with onboard systems like the galaxy map, fully immersing yourself in the role of a seasoned space treasure hunter.

[*]Solve Intricate Puzzles. Engage with the environment to uncover hidden puzzles that simultaneously challenge your thinking and reveal deeper layers of the game’s universe and the mystery surrounding Edem.

[*]Visceral VR combat. Master intense combat system — seamlessly switch between firearms and sci-fi melee weapons, wield a laser shield for defense, and outmaneuver your foes to survive!
